Vinícius Júnior Red-Carded in Real Madrid Match

Real Madrid player Vinícius Júnior received a straight red card during a match against Villarreal for pulling the hair of an opponent. The incident occurred during the game, and he will now face a ban from the upcoming El Clásico match.
